deal_value.notes: Approximately $240M cash plus ~13.2M shares of nCino common stock; ~$1.2B announced value. Stock component meant actual value at close (Jan 2022) fluctuated with NCNO share price.

calculable.implied_multiple: ~28.8x deal value / TTM revenue (or ~22x on annualized revenue incl. LBA Ware)
calculable.calculation: $1,200M / $41.6M TTM revenue = 28.8x; alternatively $1,200M / ~$54M annualized revenue including October 2021 LBA Ware acquisition = ~22.2x; vs. actual FY2023 SimpleNexus subscription revenue contribution of ~$59.8M ($344.8M total minus $285.0M organic per nCino FY23 results) = ~20.1x
inputs: Deal value ~$1.2B ($240M cash + ~13.2M NCNO shares) - https://investor.ncino.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ncino-signs-definitive-agreement-acquire-simplenexus/ and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001566895/000156689521000036/pressreleaseofncinoinc1116.htm
SimpleNexus TTM revenue $41.6M; revenue for year ended Sept 30 2021 of $40.6M; ~$54M annualized incl. LBA Ware - https://www.techbuzznews.com/ncino-acquires-simplenexus-for-1-2-billion/

SimpleNexus FY2023 subscription revenue contribution ~$59.8M implied ($344.8M total subscription vs $285.0M organic) - https://investor.ncino.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ncino-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2023-financial/
calculable.caveats: SimpleNexus was private; its revenue figures come from trade press (TechBuzz News) rather than the nCino press release itself. Stock consideration makes precise deal value time-dependent.

notes: Announced Nov 16, 2021; closed Jan 2022 (end of nCino fiscal Q4 FY22). The 28.8x revenue multiple and the $41.6M TTM / ~$54M annualized revenue figures were surfaced in search results attributed to trade press coverage (TechBuzz News, a Utah tech outlet); the multiple is arithmetically consistent ($1,200M/$41.6M=28.8x) but was not verified directly on-page (SEC and investor pages returned 403 to fetch). No EV-basis multiple published; deal-value/revenue used as proxy.
